title: console: list views draw no export control, although the view declares exportOptions and the server's export door answers 200
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-06** of track 1 (the full inventory pass), by the cloud tester `session_01RDJeRTLG52XkaPbYRvzLJf`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `b94cf856` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-full-pass-2026-10-20` at `f7297f63d`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it. The suspected landing below is the tester's reading. Paths under `src/`, `assets/` and `scripts/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL / steps:** admin and na.rep, `/_console/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/crm_lead` (All Leads). I looked in:
  - the toolbar (Filter, Display, Search);
  - the Display popover;
  - the page "More actions" menu (Add to favorites, Open in new tab, Copy link);
  - the DOM, for any "Export" text.
- **Expected:** ADM-005: CSV/XLSX export for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities and cases. `lead.view.ts:228` declares `exportOptions: { formats: ['csv','xlsx'] }`.
- **Actual:**
  - No export entry exists for either persona; the DOM holds no "Export" string.
  - The server side works: `GET /api/v1/data/crm_lead/export?format=csv` → 200 CSV for the rep and for the marketing user, and → 403 `EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED` for campaign/quote. The gate holds, but no door is drawn.
- **Evidence:** [`81-ADM-005-admin-list-more-actions.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f7297f63d58f8c3e1b9b466ee241a05d3af9a5c8/qa/2026-10-20-full-pass/shots/81-ADM-005-admin-list-more-actions.png), [`81-ADM-005-admin-display-popover.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f7297f63d58f8c3e1b9b466ee241a05d3af9a5c8/qa/2026-10-20-full-pass/shots/81-ADM-005-admin-display-popover.png).
- **class:** a. **reach:** the console list view.
- **Suspected landing spot:** the console (objectui) list toolbar, which does not render `exportOptions` in this console pin. Upstream, not `src/`.
- **Dedupe words:** `exportOptions`, `export button missing`, `list export`.
- **Known carrier:** none (#817, closed, was about the case view lacking `exportOptions`).

## Dedupe

Method: all 4,852 objectui issues (every state), listed through `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues?state=all` and matched case-insensitively on their titles. The search API was rate-limited at filing time.
- `export (button|control|entry|menu|toolbar)|exportOptions|list export|no export`: 8 hits, all closed. The nearest is objectui#4585: SpecBridge handed ObjectGrid a bare `exportOptions` array, so declared formats were ignored. The `exportOptions` reconciliation family (#4535, #6956, #7762, #8731) is closed too. A possible regression of that family on this pin.
